summary.text: Clifton Brown, an unaffiliated carpenter, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Colorado's 3rd District to Jeff Hurd.
In a Ballotpedia survey he said he would accept no corporate or PAC money and favored ending congressional districts.

paragraphs.text: Brown graduated from Cherry Creek High School and has worked as a carpenter, according to Ballotpedia.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he stated that he would not accept money from any corporation or PAC and would not earn more than his government salary.
He received 1.6% of the vote to Jeff Hurd's 49.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
